title: numpybook
universal_lens: NumPy's array abstraction unifies discrete mathematics, linear algebra, and computational physics through structured memory layouts and broadcasting semantics. Broadcasting multi-dimensional arrays through shared iteration and dimension alignment enables compositional tensor operations across heterogeneous data structures.
gsi_mapping: GSI infers probabilistic data structures from NumPy arrays via Bayesian update rules on tensorial state spaces using conformal predictive distributions. Bayesian inference over multi-array broadcast spaces leverages flag-based metadata for probabilistic consistency checks during concurrent array processing.
gse_mapping: GSE models dynamic system evolution through array-based state transitions governed by stride-aware indexing and kernel convolution operators. Situational reasoning in GSE models array state transitions via iterative broadcasting kernels, tracking dimensionality shifts and memory alignment constraints.
